open_points.subject: Repair view (A15 rule 6) record selection in `surface`
open_points.text: State 2 A15 rule 6: "For repair an agent receives ... the latest NodeExecutions, in reverse store order, of function nodes pinned to any contract version of that slot"; State 3 says: "A NodeExecution names the implementation it executed ... so for the repair view `surface` ... pages the NodeExecutions whose executed implementation is in that set".
open_points.question: Must the repair view include function-node NodeExecutions where `executed` is absent (`skipped_by_guard` / `upstream_failed`), and if yes, how are they associated to a slot without re-deriving from raw run+flow topology?
options: Include only NodeExecutions that have `executed` set to an implementation in the slot’s implementation set.
Include all function-node NodeExecutions for runs whose pinned flow contains that slot’s contract versions, including records with `executed` absent.
Include executed records by default, and include absent-`executed` records only when they can be linked through additional stored linkage fields.
open_points.default_guess: Include only NodeExecutions with `executed` implementation in the slot set, because that is the only linkage State 3 assigns explicitly.
